{icon:bullet,1.2} Gain {c_important}Cyclone Armor{/c} for free. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Cyclone Armor{/c} grants {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} Damage Reduction and triggers when Close enemies damage you. This effect can only happen once every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, affected by Cooldown Reduction.
